book.name: 1 Koronti
book.title: Pwoo ɗinshee ɗi Pool ran Nen Koronti mo

content: Jeplep Mǝ Kristi Mo
Nǝ ret kǝ gurum mo man mun a kaa jeplep kǝ Kristi mo sǝ, kǝ kaa nenɗak mo, ɗe Naan wur kǝ ten le zeen mbii fir ɗesǝsok mo ndǝǝn sar fun sǝ.
Nǝ a tǝng nen ɗe mo kǝ ten le zeen nǝ nsar fur, ɓe mo ɗee a nenyil ɗe mon ncínzeen mmo.
Baa nǝ daampee wen kas koo dǝɓen, katɗang wu cham an, koo ɗe cham nǝ a nluɗyeel mǝ gurum mo, baa wen kǝn tokɗyeel nsen kas.
Wen man nǝ, baa an ɗel ɗike kas, amma jir kǝsǝ, ɓe baa nǝ kám nǝ wen a nen nshikbish kas. A Daa wur a gwe ɗe wur tokɗyeel wen.

Mɓǝmǝnǝ ɓe, taji wu canɗyeel nkaa mee gurum kas, atǝng pee nǝ wul akuɗang. Wu gong waaji nDaa. Daa wur njì le mbii ɗe mo a sǝsok mo ɗee agaak, kǝ wur nwang pan ɗe mo ndǝǝn pǝtuup kǝ gurum mo ɗee agaak zak. A nchiit kǝ mǝnǝ ɓe koo a weyii, ɓe Naan wun nkwoop wur nchiit-nchiit kǝ kwoop ɗe nǝ ret kǝ wu kat.

Yaksǝ ɗyemnaa mo, wen kǝn sat sǝmpwoo ɗǝsǝ mo nkaa Apolos kǝ sen fen, mbǝkǝ mu ɗee ɗi a mbiikám pee wun ɗi, <<Taji wu cìn mbii mo met mbii ɗi mo kǝ ten ran nǝ kas,>> Kǝ taji memee fuu cìn roop nkaa mee gurum, kǝ wur ɓees mee gurum ɗi kas zak.
A wii le waa met niyee mo yii? Baa dǝ a Naan shin mbii ɗe waa kǝ mo jir kas aa? Katɗang nǝ aasǝ, ɓe a me le ɗang gha kǝ ɗyeepkáa ye, kaa baají waa lǝlap a nzuum sǝ kas sǝ aa?
Wuu ten wu kat mbii ɗe wuu Rǝɓet mo jir. Wuu ten wu ɗee a nenlong mo. Wuu ɗee a mishkoom mo, baa ashak kǝ mun kas. Ɗyen wen kǝ ɗe wuu ten wu ɗee a mishkoom mo, kǝ mun ɗee ɗi a mishkoom ashak kǝ wun.

Nnaa mǝnǝ, ɓe Naan wu kǝ le mun a jeplep Jesu mo. Muu ɗee a nen ɗe mo tong sham sǝǝt nǝ, kaa nen ɗe mo kǝ ten canɗyeel muut mmo sǝ, mbǝkǝ mo twe mun ɗi nyit gurum mo ɗes. Mu ɗee a mbiishwar nyil nǝ jir, nyit mǝ Nenlep Naan mo, kǝ nyit gurum mo zak.
Mu ɗee a mwen mo mɓe sǝm kǝ Kristi, amma wun a nenseen mo ndǝǝn Kristi. Baa mun kǝ ɓal kas, amma wun kǝ ɓal. Gurum mo shìn ɗeɗes nwun, amma mo ɓees mun.
Har yaksǝ ɓe neen kǝ láa mmun, kǝ neen am kǝ tu mun. Muu jwal a goklee mo, kǝ gurum moo nas mun. Baa mun kǝ mee tul kas.
Muu cìn ɗak ɓalɓal shi sar fun mo. Katɗang gurum mo ɓees mun, ɓe muu le ɗeret nkaa mo. Katɗang mo lejeel mmun, ɓe muu gung.
Katɗang mo satpwoo ɗebish nkaa mun, ɓe muu lap mmo shi pwoo ɗeret. Yaksǝ, ɓe mo ɗee a kaa zungtung ɗi gurum moo ɓeerpee ɗe sǝ. Muu ɗee a mbii ɗebish ɗe koo weyii kǝ cii mun ndǝǝn yil nǝ.
Wen kǝn ran ɗesǝ nwun, baa a mbǝkǝ an cin yitluwaan ɗi nwun kas, amma a mbǝkǝ nghan kámshii nǝ ɗi nwun, kaa jep fen ɗi nghan wal mmo sǝ.
Koo ɗang ɗi wun kǝ nenkám mo ngal kaapaat ndǝǝn Kristi, amma ɓe wun kǝ puun a mǝndong. Mɓǝɗǝ ndǝǝn Jesu Kristi, ɓe wen kǝn ɗee a puun fuu ndǝǝn pwoo ɗeret nǝ.
Mɓǝmǝnǝ, ɓe Wen kǝn ɗang pǝ wun, kǝ wu mwaan ndǝǝn shiimwaan fen zak.

A mbii ɗe nǝ le mmǝnǝ, ɗangɓe Wen kǝn lep Timoti, ɗyem fen, ɗe wen wal nwur, ɗe wur kǝ ɗar ɓalɓal ndǝǝn Daa, dǝm pee wun ɗǝ. Wur yee nwun nkaa mwaan fen ndǝǝn Kristi Jesu. Mwaan fen nǝ nchiit-nchiit kǝ mbii ɗi Wen kǝn kám ngurum mo, koo a nneye ndǝǝn Ekǝlisya mo.
Pak mo ndǝǝn wun, moo roop kaa baa wen nkuɗi kǝn mbaadǝm pee wun ɗi kas sǝ.
Katɗang Daa wur rǝɓet, kǝ wen dǝm pee wun ɗi kǝlak-kǝlak, ɓe wen nnaa mbii ɗe nenroop nǝ moo sat, kǝ wen nnaa iiko ɗe mo kǝ nǝ zak.
Baa mulki Naan nǝ a sat shi pwoo kas, amma nǝ a iiko.
Wu rǝɓet a ɗeɗangyii? Kyet wen njì pee wun ɗi a shi mbwat wo? Koo ɗang a shi wal mǝ riin ɗe nǝ a pǝɗok yii?
